debug_stop.stopped_record.en: The debug container has stopped. Its record remains until the Pod is replaced.
debug_stop.stopped_record.zh-CN: 调试容器已停止，其记录会保留至 Pod 被替换。

debug_stop.stop_description.en: Stops this debug container and its sessions. Application containers keep running. The debug container cannot be restarted.
debug_stop.stop_description.zh-CN: 停止此调试容器及其终端会话，业务容器继续运行。此调试容器停止后无法重新启动。

debug_stop.replaced.en: This Pod was replaced. Refresh before stopping its debug container.
debug_stop.replaced.zh-CN: Pod 已被替换，请刷新后再停止调试容器。

debug_stop.timeout.en: Timed out stopping the debug container. Refresh its status before retrying.
debug_stop.timeout.zh-CN: 停止调试容器超时，请刷新状态后再重试。

debug_stop.missing.en: The selected ephemeral container no longer exists.
debug_stop.missing.zh-CN: 所选临时容器已不存在。

debug_stop.legacy.en: This debug container was created without safe stop support. Its entry is removed when the Pod is replaced.
debug_stop.legacy.zh-CN: 此调试容器创建时未启用安全停止功能，其记录将在 Pod 被替换后移除。

debug_stop.not_running.en: The debug container is not running yet. Refresh its status before stopping it.
debug_stop.not_running.zh-CN: 调试容器尚未运行，请刷新状态后再尝试停止。

debug_stop.no_ack.en: The debug container did not acknowledge the stop request.
debug_stop.no_ack.zh-CN: 调试容器未确认停止请求。
